In The High Court At Calcutta
Supp. Sl. No.3 Criminal Revisional Jurisdiction
 akd/AP
 C. R. R. 2450 of 2025

In Re: Prithwis Gozi @ Prithwish Gozi & Anr.
 ... Petitio
 Mr. Navanil De
 Mr. Srinjan Ghosh
 ... ... for the petitioners

1 .  The instant criminal revisional application has been filed by the  petitioners under Section 401 of the Bharatiya Nargarik Suraksha  Sanhita, 2023 read with Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure  corresponding to Section 442 read with Section 528 of the Bharatiya  Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 for quashing the proceeding in  connection with G.R. Case No.711 of 2019 and T.R. No.68 of 2020  arising out of Narendrapur Police Station Case No.134 of 2019 dated  26.01.2019 under Sections 498A/406/313 of the Indian Penal Code.

entities.text: Narendrapur Police Station Case No.134 of 2019
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 2. Learned Advocate representing the petitioners submitted the  opposite party no.2 being the wife of petitioner no.1 had filed a  complaint on 26.01.2019 based on which Narendrapur Police Station  Case No.134 of 2019 dated 26.01.2019 under Sections 498A/406/313  of the Indian Penal Code had been registered.
On completion of  investigation, charge sheet being 1441 of 2019 dated 31.10.2019 was  filed under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code.
Subsequently  charge was framed on 03.03.2022 against the present petitioners and  date for recording of evidence was fixed on 27.12.2022.

The opposite  party no.2 preferred a fresh application for further investigation unde Section 173(2)(ii) of the Code of Criminal Procedure on 03.12.2022 CRR/2450/2025 on 30 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/31790543/
1  which was not moved before the trial court thereafter.
 3.
During pendency of the instant criminal proceeding

, the petitione  no.1 had filed an application under Section 13(1)(a)(b) of the Hindu  2 Marriage Act, 1955 against the opposite party no.2 on 07.02.2019 which was pending for adjudication before the learned Additional District Judge at Serampore being Matrimonial Suit No.92 of 2019.

4. The materials on record revealed the opposite party no.2 had filed the complaint after eight years of the alleged incident whereby she initially stated an offence been committed under Section 313 of the Indian Penal Code.

However, the same was not substantiated through the registration of the Narendrapur Police Station Case No.134 of 2019 which was filed under Section 498A abrogating Section 313 of the Indian Penal Code.

Subsequently, the opposite party no.2 continued with her matrimonial life and gave birth to a child as has been substantiated by the statements of the father and mother of the victim lady as recorded under Section 161 of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
5. Presence of the State-respondents is required for adjudication of the instant revisional application since the materials in the case diary are to be assessed in its entirety.
6. Petitioners are directed to serve upon the opposite parties intimating the next date of hearing and file affidavit-of-service on the adjourned date.
7. In the meantime, the proceeding of G.R. Case No.711 of 2019 arising out of Narendrapur Police Station Case No.134 of 2019 dated 26.01.2019 shall remain stayed until further orders.

2

2025.

(Ananya Bandyopadhyay, J.)
